ios.desc:
Racketile is an async multiplayer word board game—crossword-style tile battles that fit your day.

Challenge players, jump into Find Match, or practice against bots. Tables hold up to 4 players (Flag Run is 1v1). When you're both in the room, the board stays live.

TEN WAYS TO DUEL
• Normal — Classic turns, no clock. Play across minutes or days.
• Plain — Like Normal—letter values only, no premium squares.
• Golf — Same as Normal—lowest score wins.
• Timed turns — Per-turn countdown; miss it and you auto-pass.
• Blitz — Each player has their own clock; if yours runs out, you're eliminated.
• Rush — Place faster for speed bonuses (+10 / +5)—no hard timeout.
• Flag Run — Capture their flag or outscore them on Ends or Corners boards, with Rush-style speed bonuses. 1v1.
• Scatter — Place words in several spots in one turn, then Submit once.
• Fog — Premiums stay hidden under fog until a tile lands on them.
• Stack — Stack new tiles on any occupied square; buried letters stay hidden; only the top counts.

Blind secondary (Timed / Blitz / Rush / Flag, human vs human): the board and rack stay hidden until you tap Show board—then the clock runs.

FEATURES
• Challenge linked players or find a match
• Practice bots from Rookie to Apex
• Push notifications when it's your turn (quiet hours supported)
• Sign in with email, Google, or Apple—or try Guest on this device
• Crossword-tile board, clear turn flow, built for phones

Free to play. No ads. Word duels, your pace.
